scope: Refuse normalized ordinary native body text below its per-viewing-mode role floor before publishing a deck. Preserve complete source and existing destinations. Generic predictions remain advisory; this is not a universal font-size resolver or visual approval.

regressions.direct_generator: All four fit modes, populated child sizes, unused styles and empty prompts, existing/missing destinations, source unchanged, and readable 18pt continuation control.
regressions.single_paragraph: Manual source-complete continuation guidance, no shortening instruction; generic prediction control remains advisory.
regressions.caller_diagnostics: Actual CLI and MCP across all four fit modes retain code, input path, grouped split_bullets max_items=2, complete source and existing destination without leaked output artifacts.
regressions.all_native_source_gate: Explicit typed readability refusals are counted separately from source-loss refusals; every attempted probe must be accounted for, and refusals never count as visual approvals.

remaining_work: Exact published CI must finish before closure. Yellow master repair is reviewed but uninstalled; its minor wrapping/chart cautions remain. Explicit-size/pattern extreme budgets and namespace-scope defects are tracked separately. Original unsafe single-page pixels are retained as adverse evidence, not silently removed or visually approved.
